response.original_title: Manchester United F.C. - The Golden Goals Collection
response.overview: Golden Goals features over 160 of the best United goals scored between 1983 - 1992.  Watch out for NORMAN WHITESIDE in the '83 Cup Final at the age of just eighteen, and two years later scoring a cracker at Wembley as United with ten men beat Everton. Remember ARTHUR ALBISTON'S terrific longshot against City in 1985, and a brilliant solo effort by GORDON STRACHAN against Arsenal in 1988. Relive those two goals in three minutes from BRIAN McCLAIR against City in 1990, an acrobatic bicycle kick from MARK HUGHES in a later Manchester derby that year, plus many inspirational strikes from Captain Marvel BRYAN ROBSON.
response.title: Manchester United F.C. - The Golden Goals Collection
